name.value: The Maq Cold Beer, Wine and Spirits

description.value: The Maq Beer and Wine Store is a retail liquor outlet located within The MAQ Hotel complex on First Street in Tofino, stocking cold beer, wine, and spirits including local BC craft products and imported selections. It operates as one of several amenities within the MAQ hospitality group, which also runs a pub, café, and restaurant on the same property. Cyclists touring the Pacific Rim region will find it a convenient stop for stocking up on beverages in Tofino's compact downtown core.

address.value: 120 First St, Tofino, British Columbia, V0R 2Z0
